# Parity-even payload gate removal: inherited contract audit

Conclusion: removing an even-coefficient pointwise payload ADD is valid for the bit supplier. The odd-prime address arithmetic remains unchanged. A new paid profile still requires the actual filtered word and full frame schedule; this conclusion alone does not certify a new kappa value.

## Operator proof

Fix the finite complete address set Omega and let one stream be a vector in F2^Omega. A payload gate is `x_a <- x_a + (c mod2) x_b`. For even c this is the identity on every input, including arbitrary correlated dirty streams and spectators. Removing any number of these identity gates leaves the complete scalar operator S_Omega unchanged. Negative odd coefficients and coefficient3 also reduce to1, though the simplest experimental witness can retain their original signed integer representatives.

Retain each original input/output frame and every remaining gate's original common frame. The common-frame identity then gives the same `D_out S_Omega D_in^-1` for the filtered word. In particular, every independent helper still has its required partial-swap residual and the existing completed-bank proof still applies. No integer identity of the new lift is needed to conclude this F2 operator identity.

## Safe frame compression

Deleting an ADD removes its operand-frame alignment requirement. For a given stream, collect successive MOVE operations between surviving uses. A use includes any surviving ADD, COPY read/write, ERASE or required phase/endpoint boundary. No use may be crossed merely because another stream is idle.

Suppose the original local frames form a nested chain U0 <= U1 <= ... <= Uk. Their exact address changes telescope to `D_Uk D_U0^-1`. Their orthogonal increments are disjoint commuting projectors, so this is one allowed residual of rank dim(Uk)-dim(U0). In the reflected orientation the chain is the reversed complementary chain; the same endpoint difference and rank follow exactly. The ambient stage background cancels. Rebuild both ledgers from the actual surviving uses and actual basis inclusions; do not infer this from summed ranks alone.

Keep every physical input/output family and its endpoint, all stage boundaries, all data routes/bridges, and every copied-center lifetime. For source527 the120 center copies in the five-stage construction have odd scatter coefficients, so parity filtering does not itself remove those episodes. The shared work stream cannot be used before COPY or after ERASE. A COPY is a barrier even if its original register has no intervening ADD.
